newFeatures: Initial release of Naa Paata music player
Local music library with import from Files app
Basic playback controls (play, pause, next, previous)
Sort songs by title, artist, duration
Now Playing screen with artwork display
Dark and light theme support
Equalizer with 9 bands (Bass, Treble, and 7 frequency bands)
Repeat modes: Off, One, All
Shuffle playback
Add songs to 'Play Next' queue
Search songs by title or artist
enhancements: Improved audio engine for better performance
Faster loading of large music libraries
bugFixes: Fixed crash when importing certain FLAC files
Fixed UI lag when scrolling large lists

newFeatures: Gapless playback for seamless transitions
Crossfade between tracks (0–12 seconds)
Fade on Play/Pause (0–1000 ms)
Widget support: control playback from Home Screen
Lock Screen controls with artwork
enhancements: Redesigned Now Playing screen with larger artwork
Smart sorting: remember last used sort option
bugFixes: Fixed audio stutter on some devices
Fixed artwork not displaying for some songs

newFeatures: Playlists: create, edit, and delete custom playlists
Add songs to playlists from Now Playing or Library
Favorites: mark songs as favorites for quick access
Recent played: history of last 50 songs
enhancements: Optimised database queries for faster playlist loading
Improved memory usage for large libraries
bugFixes: Fixed playlist songs not persisting after app restart
Fixed crash when adding a song to a playlist

newFeatures: AirPlay support: stream music to AirPlay devices
CarPlay integration: control playback in the car
enhancements: Now Playing screen now shows waveform animation
Better error handling for corrupted audio files
bugFixes: Fixed audio cutting off when receiving notifications
Fixed shuffle not working correctly with large playlists
Fixed crash when opening the app on some devices
Fixed missing artwork for certain MP3 files
Fixed 'Play Next' not working when queue is empty
